gui.avemujica.title: Ave Mujica · Management Office
gui.avemujica.subtitle: STAGE MANAGEMENT / BAND CAREER
gui.avemujica.overworld_required: Management is only available in the Overworld
gui.avemujica.stage_ready: Stage ready for rehearsal or concert
gui.avemujica.footer: Validated by server · Results in chat · ESC to close
gui.avemujica.tip.0: Uses real emeralds in your inventory. First recruitment 8; replacement 3 each.
gui.avemujica.tip.1: Pay 2 emeralds; permanently trains all five members.
gui.avemujica.tip.2: Pay 2 emeralds; earn 3–8 emeralds and fans, claimable after the show.
gui.avemujica.tip.3: Pay 4 emeralds; earn 8–25 emeralds and rewards in a verified village, with per-village cooldown.
gui.avemujica.tip.5: Upgrade sound and ticket price, max level 5.
gui.avemujica.midi.list.tip: Open the server song library and select a MIDI inside the GUI.
gui.avemujica.midi.play.tip: Browse and filter bundled and server MIDI files.
gui.avemujica.midi.stop.tip: Stop your currently playing MIDI track.
message.avemujica.solo_owned: This musician belongs to another player’s band.
message.avemujica.solo_busy: This musician is performing or cooling down from a solo.
gui.avemujica.tip.7: Claim real emeralds and tour loot; overflow drops near you.
